buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 4. Service & Support The Service Provider is required to have at least 30 % of the required manpower on service provider’s payroll for at least one year. Necessary documents relating to such manpower will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the

Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 5. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: The invitation for bids is open to agencies fulfilling the eligibility criteria as detai led below:- 1. The bidder must possess a valid license certificate issued under the Priv ate Security Agencies (Regulation) Act. 2. The bidder must be in possession of valid license from Central or State G overnment or other competent authorities issued under Central/ State Labour A ct for running a security agency. 3. Bidder should have a minimum of three years of experience in providing manpower services, for outsourcing services of Security Guards to various Gove rnment Organizations since FY 2023-24. 4. The bidder must have obtained a Permanent Account Number (PAN) und er the Income-tax Act, 1961. The bidder must produce the certificate of incorpor ation 5. The evidence for filing of returns along with Income and Expenditure Ac count and Balance Sheet for past three Financial Years 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (Assessment Years 2023-24 to 2026-27) should be enclosed along with the qualifying bid. 6. The bidder must have gross contractual receipts of Rs. 1.15 Crores and above during the last two financial years 2024-25 & 2025-26. A statement show ing list of clients along with evidence for contractual receipts should be enclose d along with the qualifying bid. The Bidder should attach Nationalized Bank Solv ency Certificate for Rupees One Crore. 7. The bidder must have valid ESI, EPF, and GST registrations as on the dat e of submission of tender, along with GST appreciation certificates, if any. 8. In the event of the contract being awarded, the contractor should be pre pared to deploy the personnel w.e.f. 01.01.2027.

9. The bidder should also be able to provide additional guards required by the Department during the contract at the existing terms. 10. The bidder should submit Memorandum of Understanding with a training institute and should also produce the recent photograph of the office or busines s location with personnel uniform and agency logo. 11. Any Additional Documents submitted after opening of Technical Bid shall not be considered. TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The service agreement under consideration is towards providing Securit y Guards on need basis for the period from 1st January 2027 to 31st December 2 027. 2. The Service Provider and Security personnel shall ensure the safety and Security of the entire premises of Income Tax Office at Coimbatore as detailed b elow: Location Required Manpower Timing Income Tax Office 09 06.00AM to 2.00PM - 3 Race Course Road 02.00PM to 10.00PM - 3 Coimbatore 641018 10.00PM to 06.00AM - 3 Total - 09 3. Security personnel should have minimum high school qualifications, wor king knowledge of English or Hindi and Tamil languages, good physique, at least 3 years’ experience of rendering Security Services and knowledge of fire fightin g. They should be in between 25 to 60 years of age and bear good moral charac ter. 4. The Service Provider shall provide suitable and clean uniforms to the Se curity personnel engaged by him. It should also be ensured that the uniforms ar e in good condition and should be washed and ironed daily. 5. Security personnel should wear complete uniform with all accessories- c ap, belt, badge, insignia, black shoes, socks, warm clothing etc. They should als o display their photo identity cards all the time while on duty. 6. The Service Provider will supply one good whistle, torch, strong bamboo stick (lathi), as per requirements, to each Security personnel. 7. The Service Provider shall furnish the names, parentage, residential add resses, age, photographs, proof of identity, and proof of address of the deployed security personnel to the Office of the Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Coim batore. 8. The Service Provider shall get the police verification done on credentials of the workforce to be employed by him in the premises and keep the original th

ereof with him/them for production to the Income Tax Office as and when desire d. However, a certified copy of Police Verification shall be submitted to O/o. the I ncome Tax Officer (HQ)(PR), Room No. 415, Race Course Road, Coimbatore. 9. Security personnel should not smoke or consume liquor or indulge in an y unhygienic activities at any public place within the office or in its vicinity whic h are prohibited under the law. 10. The Service Provider is solely responsible for maintaining statutorily req uired registers for efficient performance of this contract. The same should be pr oduced to the Officer-in-charge for inspection as and when required Security per sonnel shall maintain in and out' duty register for themselves. 11. Security personnel shall be responsible for physical verification of the pe rsons of other Service Providers / Service Provider engaged in the entire above- mentioned campus going in and outside the premises and maintain their 'in an d out' record. 12. Security personnel shall be responsible for proper entry of the visitors an d vehicles after receiving due permission from concerned officials / Service Prov iders / hostellers over intercom/phone. The Security personnel should ensure th at no person enters into the premises unauthorized. They shall maintain records of visitors along with the vehicles which enter the premises. They shall also ens ure that vehicles are parked only in the designated parking area. 13. Security personnel shall be responsible for the physical verification and counting of incoming and outgoing material. Security personnel must ensure th at materials exit only with a Gate Pass or Challan issued by the competent auth ority. Specimen signatures of the authorized officials must be kept on record by the security agency for verification purposes. Security personnel on the night sh ift must ensure that all rooms in the building are properly closed and that all swi tches in those rooms are turned off. They must also ensure that no unauthorized persons occupy any rooms in the office complex. Lights in commo n areas—namely corridors, porticos, and garden areas—should be switched on a nd off at the appropriate times. 14. Security personnel shall lend support periodically for all fire extinguisher s and fire hydrants installed in the premises. 15. Security personnel shall be responsible for maintenance of key register and maintenance of key records. The keys handed over to the security personn el should be safely kept and the register must be updated accordingly. 16. Security personnel shall ensure that no unauthorized person enters the premises or hawkers put their shop/stall near the boundary walls. 17. It is clearly agreed and understood that all the persons provided / engag ed by the Service Provider, shall be the employees of the Service Provider and a ll disputes between the Service Provider and its personnel shall have no bearing on the O/o. the Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Coimbatore. O/o. the Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Coimbatore, shall not be responsible for any claims made by such persons and shall not be liable to pay any am

ount to any personnel/ ex-employee of the Service provider. The Servic e Provider is fully responsible for disciplined behaviour of its workmen. 18. The Service Provider shall maintain proper records of the attendance of t he Security personnel engaged by it for rendering Security Services and ensure that gates will never remain unattended by Security guard/guards. Such records should be produced for verification as and when required by the O/o. the Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Coimbatore. Any absenteeism of Security Guards on any particular day is to be made good by providing substitute standby witho ut loss of time to ensure that the work is uninterrupted. The details of substitute provided must be intimated to this office for better monitoring of service. 19. The Security personnel shall be deployed on rotation basis as and where needed. No Security Guard should be deployed for more than eight hours contin uously and norms of labour laws & rules must be adhered to in this regard. The Service Provider shall comply with the provisions of all the applicable Labour La ws and any amendments/modification thereto, or any other law relating thereto and Rules may there under from time to time and comply with all provisions ap plicable therein and/or make all the payments specified therein. 20. The Service Provider shall be fully responsible for complying with the pro visions (including documentation and submission of reports on the above to the statutory authorities) and shall indemnify the O/o. the Chief Commissioner of Inc ome Tax, Coimbatore from any such lapse for which the Government /Statutory authorities there under any take action against the Service Provider. 21. The Service Provider will be paid the contractual amount per month for t he above Services and except the above amount this Office will not pay anythin g either to the Service Provider or its Security Personnel. If additional Security P ersonnel in excess of the number specified in the contract are specifically requir ed by the Office on any occasion, the payment for such additional personnel sha ll be made to the Service Provider as per the minimum wages rate prescribed b y the competent authority. 22. The Service Provider shall be liable to pay his contribution and his emplo yees’ contribution to the State Insurance Scheme, Provident Fund Authorities, e tc. in respect of all its employees for the performance of its obligations under thi s agreement in accordance with the provisions of Employees State Insurance Ac t 1948. Employees Provident Fund and Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1952 as am ended from time to time. 23. The Service Provider shall abide by the Minimum Wages Act 1948 (Govt of India. Act No.11 of 1948 dated 15.03.1948) and other applicable enactment, r ules and regulations. In case of variation in minimum wages as prescribed by th e competent authority, the contract amount will be modified to the extent off th e increase in the wages payable by the Service Provider to its Security Personne l other workers under this contract. 24. The Service Provider shall be solely and exclusively liable and responsibl e to its Security Personnel or other workers for the following.

a) The payment of wages, allowances and other benefits as per pro vision of Minimum Wages Act or any other applicable act or enactments in force from time to time. b) The payment of compensation under the Workman's Compensati on Act or any other applicable act or enactments. In case of injury or dea th of any of its Security personnel/other worker. c) Any other allowances or benefits as admissible under different la ws, rules and enactments to Security Personnel/other employees, inclu ding weekly rest/off day's leave, national holidays etc. 25. The Security Personnel/other workers deployed by the Service Provider f or the work/ Service as specified in this document shall be employees of the Ser vice Provider/Services Provider for all intents and purposes and in no case shall have a relationship of employer and employee between the O/o. the Chief Com missioner of Income Tax, Coimbatore and said persons shall accrue implicitly or explicitly. 26. The Security Provider shall be duty bound to obtain and possess all statu tory registrations, licenses (Including PSARA), permissions, approvals etc. from t he Competent Authorities for providing required Services as per the terms and c onditions of the contract and furnish the copies thereof to the O/o. the Chief Co mmissioner of Income Tax, Coimbatore as and when required. In case the Servic e Provider fails to do so, the contract shall be terminated. 27. The Service Provider agrees and undertakes to bear all taxes, rates, cha rges, levies or claims whatsoever as may be imposed by the State/ Central Govt. or any local body or any other competent authority. 28. The Service Provider shall be responsible for any damage to the land & b uildings. equipment's, furniture & fixtures, vehicles, other items and articles wit hin the said premises, if such damage in the opinion of the Office is due to negli gence or carelessness or any fault on part of the Service Provider or its employe es or workers. The Service Provider shall be liable to pay to the O/o. the Chief C ommissioner of Income Tax, Coimbatore such amount in respect of such damag e as may be assessed by O/o. the Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Coimbato re. 29. Without prejudice to the preceding terms of contract, the Service will be liable to reimburse the O/o. the Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Coimbatore any cost or legal liability/penalty/fine imposed on the O/o. the Commissioner of I ncome Tax (Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore by any authority, because of any work ers/any other persons deployed by the Service Provider. 30. The O/o. the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore s hall make the contract payment as per the schedule mentioned below: (a) The Service Provider will be paid Rs.1180.96/- per day per perso nnel (Excluding GST). (b) Monthly bills complete in all respects along with statement show ing number of Security personnel deployed for number of days, copy of atten

dance register and proof for payment of GST and Provident Fund contributions f or individual personnel relating to previous month shall be enclosed and subm itted by the Service Provider. Bill will normally be paid as early as possible. No advance payments shall be made. (c) Following deductions/adjustments shall be made from the bills b efore making the payment. (i) Income Tax deductions at sources as per statutory provisi ons. (ii) The amount equivalent to any damages/loss etc caused t o the O/o. the Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Coimbatore whi ch is attributable to the Service Provider, and any other char ges (Penalties and other deductions etc) (d) For making payment towards Monthly bill on time, the service prov ider shall furnish the statements of ESI, PF and other statutory payme nt details along with the monthly bill. (e) The Service provider should have sufficient funds for payment of s alary to the employees in the event of any unforeseen circumstances of non-payment of claim by the department to the Bidder. The Service provider should make payment to the manpower resources through bank transfer only on or before 5th of every month irrespective of bills c leared by the Buyer. In no circumstances cash payment shall be made. (f) The Service Provider shall submit the bill for every month within 5t h day of the succeeding month by the Service Provider to the Drawi ng and Disbursing Officer, Office of the Commissioner of Income T ax (Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore. No interim bills will be entertain ed. 31. The Service Provider shall be permitted to consume water and electricity for rendering the Service contract and the cost of these items shall be borne by the Office. They shall be allowed to use the toilet facilities also. 32. The Service Provider shall furnish a detailed list of his employees along with their addresses, Photo identity proof to the O/o. the Income Tax Officer (HQ ) (PR), Room No.415, Race Course Road, Coimbatore. The Security Personnel/ot her workers of the Service Provider shall have no right to stay in the campus be yond their duty hours. 33. The EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) submitted by the Service Provider wit h the prequalification bid, would be held by the O/o the Income Tax Officer (HQ) (PR), Room No.415, Race Course Road, Coimbatore as Security Deposit and shal l be refunded upon furnishing the performance bank guarantee and signing the contract. No interest shall be payable by the O/o the Income Tax Officer (HQ) (P R), Room No.415, Race Course Road, Coimbatore on EMD. If exemption is applic able proper certificate shall be furnished in this regard. 34. If the Service Provider fails to deploy requisite number of Security Perso nnel as per the terms of contract or their staff is found missing, the Office shall i mpose a penalty of Rs.500/- per person per day for short deployment of staff. 35. The office shall have the right to withhold any reasonable sums from the

amounts payable to the Service Provider under this contract, if the Service Provi der commits breach of any of the terms and conditions with regards to payment of all statutory and other sues or compliance with statutory or other obligations. 36. After the award of contract, the Service Provider shall be initially on trial for two months, subject to fortnightly review of performance. The continuance o f the contract for the remaining period shall be subject to the satisfactory perfor mance during the trial period. 37. This agreement shall be in force only for the period of one year from the date of execution of the contract (i.e., 01.01.2027), and may be extended for a f urther period of a maximum of two months at a time after a review of the Servic e Provider's performance and at the sole discretion of the O/o. the Commissione r of Income Tax (Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore, on the same terms and conditions. 38. In the event of instances of gross misbehaviour, theft, burglary, moral tu rpitude, misuse of the occupied area, breach of contract, unsatisfactory Service s etc by the Service Provider or by any Staff/agent of the Service Provider, the O /o. the Commissioner of Income Tax(Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore may forthwith terminate this contract summarily without previous notice to the Service Provid er and Service provider shall have no claim whatsoever against the O/o. the Co mmissioner of Income Tax(Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore or any of its officers in c onsequence of such termination. 39. In case the Service Provider assigns or sub-contacts this contract to som e other person or attempts to do so, this Office shall have the right to terminate the agreement without giving any notice to the Service Provider. 40. The O/o. the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore s hall have the right to unilaterally terminate the contract without specifying or as signing any reasons for the same, by giving one month's notice to the Service P rovider. In such a case O/o the Income Tax Officer (HQ) (PR), Room No.415, Rac e Course Road, Coimbatore shall return the performance guarantee to the Servi ce Provider within ten days after termination of the contract subject to the clear ance of any damages due upon the Service Provider and vacation of the premis es. 41. On termination of contract by the Office for any reason whatsoever, the Office shall be entitled to engage the Services of any other person, agency or Se rvice Provider to meet the requirement without prejudice to its rights including c laim for damages against the Service Provider. 42. The Performance Bank Guarantee will be released by the Office of the In come Tax Officer (HQ) (PR), Room No. 415, Race Course Road, Coimbatore, upo n contract expiry, provided that all articles have been handed over and no equi pment or property under the service provider's security has been damaged. In c ase of any damage to articles, equipment, or property attributable to the Servic e Provider, the equivalent cost of damages will be intimated to the Service Provi der. This amount must be paid by the Service Provider before the Performance Bank Guarantee is released. If payment is delayed by more than 15 days, the Of

fice of the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore may, at its discretion, recover the amount directly from the Performance Bank Guarantee. 43. The Service Provider shall co-operate with the other Service Providers an d their workers working in the campus. 44. All disputes arising out of this contract shall be subject to the ju risdiction of courts of Coimbatore. 45. However, no dispute shall be taken by either party to the contract to any court of law without first referring it to an arbitrator, who will be appointed by th e Office of the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) Unit-1, Coimbatore. Any d ecision of the arbitrator will be final and binding on both parties and shall not be appealable in any court of law, except on the grounds of malafide or perversity 46. The service provider should provide increased or decreased manpower a s per the requirement under the same terms and conditions. 47. At no cost any security personnel should be made to work any additional hours and the duty timing should be strictly adhered. 48. In the event of any replacement of security personnel due to leave, abse nteeism, or non-reporting, the Service Provider must intimate the Office of the I ncome Tax Officer (HQ) (PR), Room No. 415, Race Course Road, Coimbatore wit hin 24 hours. The identity particulars of the replacement security personnel mus t also be submitted within this timeframe. 49. The agreement can be terminated by either party after giving prior notic e. The Notice period shall not be less than thirty days. 50. The Service Provider must have a local office in Coimbatore, sub mit address proof, and provide contact details for a designated liaison. .
